observation.observation: Aircraft is approaching WTC2 from the left; tower is not yet impacted.
Aircraft is much closer to WTC2 than in 736. WTC2 still has no fireball.
Fireballs erupt to the sides of WTC2; plume is lower and less developed than in 739.
Fireballs have expanded and risen, with greater descending debris than in 738.
Aircraft visible approaching WTC2. WTC2 has no impact fireball; WTC1 is already smoking.
Compact nascent fireball from WTC2, with falling debris. Earlier phase than the expanded fireball in 803.
Expanded bright lobed fireball beside WTC2; two distinctive debris fragments below it. Same scene details as NIST figure 7-5 after crop and grayscale conversion.
Fireball has risen and darkened, with a smaller bright area near its upper center. WTC1 edges and lobe contours match NIST figure 7-8 after crop and grayscale conversion.
Visible fireball has mostly extinguished; a dark thermal rises above WTC2. No exact time can be read.
Thermal has risen and spread further; viewpoint/crop is tighter. No exact time can be read.
